summary: Iteration 6 testing of the Claude Sonnet 5 multi-model addition to Ask Finaura. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_chat_models.py (9 tests) covering GET /api/chat/models, anonymous + authenticated streaming for openai and claude, unknown-model fallback, missing-model default, and invalid-token graceful degradation — all 9 pass. Full regression suite (/app/backend/tests, 72 tests) = 63 passed, 6 skipped, 0 failed. Frontend: verified model picker on /demo/ask and /ask (active class flip, placeholder swap, localStorage persistence across reload), per-message msg-model-N tags for both models with history preserved, plus regressions (sign-in -> dashboard, statements CSV upload/column-mapping, passkey section in Settings, demo banner, sign-out clearing token). One pre-existing personalisation gap found in the chat system prompt.

minor.issue: For demo-data users (has_demo_data=true, empty profile{}) the system prompt injects 'monthly_income unknown, monthly_expenses unknown...' so the assistant replies "I don't have your monthly income on file" even though GET /api/financial/overview reports income 185000 / expenses 123000 for the same user. _system_prompt lacks the DEMO_SUMMARY fallback that overview() has (server.py L175-178). Reproduced with testuser@finaura.dev on both openai and claude.

action_items: Give _system_prompt the same demo-data fallback as overview(): when has_demo_data and profile=={} inject DEMO_SUMMARY numbers so Claude/GPT answers match the dashboard instead of saying the profile is unknown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~430 lines and fine, but the demo-summary fallback logic is now duplicated conceptually between overview() and _system_prompt() — extract a single `resolve_summary(user, goals)` helper to keep chat context and dashboard numbers in sync (DRY).

CHAT_MODELS.get(payload.model or 'openai', CHAT_MODELS['openai']) silently falls back for unknown ids; consider echoing the resolved id in X-Model (already the label) or returning 422 for typo'd model ids so clients don't silently get the wrong provider.
Frontend Ask(): the fetch stream has no r.ok check — an HTTP 503 (missing EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) would render the error body as the assistant reply instead of the friendly fallback message.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Uploaded a 2-row CSV (TEST_COFFEE/TEST_SALARY) to the statements column-mapping step only; import was not confirmed, so no transactions were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response key is 'access_token' (not 'token'). Sign-in form testids are login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button. Chat streaming takes 5-20s; poll until the assistant text stops growing rather than breaking on first non-empty chunk. Model picker testids: model-picker, model-choice-openai, model-choice-claude, msg-model-{index}. X-Model response header carries the resolved label ('OpenAI GPT-5.4' / 'Claude Sonnet 5').
rca_of_the_issue: Personalisation gap: overview() branches to DEMO_SUMMARY when has_demo_data && profile=={} (server.py L175), but _system_prompt() (L316) reads only user['profile'], producing 'unknown' values in the LLM context. Fix by sharing one summary resolver.
